audit_status.source_base: Greek Gospel text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for resurrection morning, Mary witnesses, angel/messenger, earthquake, empty tomb, Jesus' greeting, guard report/bribe, Galilee meeting, authority, discipling nations, baptismal formula, teaching/keeping, and presence to completion of age.

verses.restored: After the Sabbath, as the first day of the week was dawning, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

familiar.text: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.

modern.text: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the tomb.

original.text: Ὀψὲ δὲ σαββάτων, τῇ ἐπιφωσκούσῃ εἰς μίαν σαββάτων, ἦλθεν ⸀Μαριὰμ ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ ἡ ἄλλη Μαρία θεωρῆσαι τὸν τάφον.

verses.restored: And look, there was a great earthquake, for a messenger of the Lord descended from heaven, came, rolled away the stone, and sat upon it.

familiar.text: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.

modern.text: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, rolled away the stone, and sat on it.

original.text: καὶ ἰδοὺ σεισμὸς ἐγένετο μέγας· ἄγγελος γὰρ κυρίου καταβὰς ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ⸀καὶ προσελθὼν ἀπεκύλισε τὸν ⸀λίθον καὶ ἐκάθητο ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ.

verses.restored: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

familiar.text: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:

modern.text: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.

original.text: ἦν δὲ ἡ εἰδέα αὐτοῦ ⸀ὡς ἀστραπὴ καὶ τὸ ἔνδυμα αὐτοῦ λευκὸν ὡς χιών.

verses.restored: From fear of him the guards trembled and became like dead ones.

familiar.text: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.

modern.text: The guards trembled in fear of him and became like dead men.

original.text: ἀπὸ δὲ τοῦ φόβου αὐτοῦ ἐσείσθησαν οἱ τηροῦντες καὶ ἐγενήθησαν ⸀ὡς νεκροί.

verses.restored: The messenger answered the women, Do not fear, for I know that you seek Jesus, the crucified one.

familiar.text: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.

modern.text: But the angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.

original.text: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ ἄγγελος εἶπεν ταῖς γυναιξίν· Μὴ φοβεῖσθε ὑμεῖς, οἶδα γὰρ ὅτι Ἰησοῦν τὸν ἐσταυρωμένον ζητεῖτε·

verses.restored: He is not here, for he was raised, as he said. Come, see the place where he lay.

familiar.text: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

modern.text: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said! Come, see the place where He lay.

original.text: οὐκ ἔστιν ὧδε, ἠγέρθη γὰρ καθὼς εἶπεν· δεῦτε ἴδετε τὸν τόπον ὅπου ⸀ἔκειτο·

verses.restored: Go quickly and tell his disciples that he was raised from the dead; and look, he goes before you to Galilee. There you will see him. Look, I have told you.

familiar.text: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.

modern.text: Then go quickly and tell His disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him.’ See, I have told you.”

original.text: καὶ ταχὺ πορευθεῖσαι εἴπατε τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ ὅτι Ἠγέρθη ἀπὸ τῶν νεκρῶν, καὶ ἰδοὺ προάγει ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν, ἐκεῖ αὐτὸν ὄψεσθε· ἰδοὺ εἶπον ὑμῖν.

verses.restored: Departing quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, they ran to report to his disciples.

familiar.text: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.

modern.text: So they hurried away from the tomb in fear and great joy, and ran to tell His disciples.

original.text: καὶ ⸀ἀπελθοῦσαι ταχὺ ἀπὸ τοῦ μνημείου μετὰ φόβου καὶ χαρᾶς μεγάλης ἔδραμον ἀπαγγεῖλαι τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ.

verses.restored: And look, Jesus met them, saying, Rejoice. They came, took hold of his feet, and bowed/prostrated before him.

familiar.text: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.

modern.text: Suddenly Jesus met them and said, “Greetings!” They came to Him, grasped His feet, and worshiped Him.

original.text: ⸀καὶ ⸀ἰδοὺ Ἰησοῦς ⸀ὑπήντησεν αὐταῖς λέγων· Χαίρετε· αἱ δὲ προσελθοῦσαι ἐκράτησαν αὐτοῦ τοὺς πόδας καὶ προσεκύνησαν αὐτῷ.

verses.restored: Then Jesus said to them, Do not fear. Go report to my brothers and sisters that they should go away to Galilee, and there they will see me.

familiar.text: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.

modern.text: “Do not be afraid,” said Jesus. “Go and tell My brothers to go to Galilee. There they will see Me.” The Report of the Guards

original.text: τότε λέγει αὐταῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Μὴ φοβεῖσθε· ὑπάγετε ἀπαγγείλατε τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς μου ἵνα ἀπέλθωσιν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν, κἀκεῖ με ὄψονται.

verses.restored: While they were going, look, some of the guard went into the city and reported to the chief priests all that had happened.

familiar.text: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.

modern.text: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests all that had happened.

original.text: Πορευομένων δὲ αὐτῶν ἰδού τινες τῆς κουστωδίας ἐλθόντες εἰς τὴν πόλιν ἀπήγγειλαν τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν ἅπαντα τὰ γενόμενα.

verses.restored: After gathering with the elders and taking counsel, they gave sufficient silver to the soldiers,

familiar.text: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,

modern.text: And after the chief priests had met with the elders and formed a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money

original.text: καὶ συναχθέντες μετὰ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων συμβούλιόν τε λαβόντες ἀργύρια ἱκανὰ ἔδωκαν τοῖς στρατιώταις

verses.restored: saying, Say that his disciples came by night and stole him while we slept.

familiar.text: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.

modern.text: and instructed them: “You are to say, ‘His disciples came by night and stole Him away while we were asleep.’

original.text: λέγοντες· Εἴπατε ὅτι Οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ νυκτὸς ἐλθόντες ἔκλεψαν αὐτὸν ἡμῶν κοιμωμένων·

verses.restored: If this is heard by the governor, we will persuade him and keep you free from trouble.

familiar.text: And if this come to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.

modern.text: If this report reaches the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble.”

original.text: καὶ ἐὰν ἀκουσθῇ τοῦτο ⸀ἐπὶ τοῦ ἡγεμόνος, ἡμεῖς πείσομεν ⸀αὐτὸν καὶ ὑμᾶς ἀμερίμνους ποιήσομεν.

verses.restored: They took the silver and did as they were taught. This word was spread among Judeans until this day.

familiar.text: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.

modern.text: So the guards took the money and did as they were instructed. And this account has been circulated among the Jews to this very day. The Great Commission (Mark 16:14–18)

original.text: οἱ δὲ λαβόντες ⸀τὰ ἀργύρια ἐποίησαν ὡς ἐδιδάχθησαν. Καὶ διεφημίσθη ὁ λόγος οὗτος παρὰ Ἰουδαίοις μέχρι τῆς σήμερον ⸀ἡμέρας.

verses.restored: The eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had appointed them.

familiar.text: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.

modern.text: Meanwhile, the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain Jesus had designated.

original.text: Οἱ δὲ ἕνδεκα μαθηταὶ ἐπορεύθησαν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν εἰς τὸ ὄρος οὗ ἐτάξατο αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς,

verses.restored: When they saw him, they bowed/prostrated, but some doubted/divided.

familiar.text: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.

modern.text: When they saw Him, they worshiped Him, but some doubted.

original.text: καὶ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν ⸀προσεκύνησαν, οἱ δὲ ἐδίστασαν.

verses.restored: Jesus came near and spoke to them, saying, All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.

familiar.text: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.

modern.text: Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.

original.text: καὶ προσελθὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς λέγων· Ἐδόθη μοι πᾶσα ἐξουσία ἐν οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐπὶ ⸀τῆς γῆς·

verses.restored: Therefore go, disciple all the nations, baptizing them into the name of the Father and of the Son and of the holy Spirit,

familiar.text: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:

modern.text: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit,

original.text: πορευθέντες ⸀οὖν μαθητεύσατε πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, ⸀βαπτίζοντες αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ τοῦ υἱοῦ καὶ τοῦ ἁγίου πνεύματος,

verses.restored: teaching them to keep all that I commanded you. And look, I am with you all the days until the completion of the age.

familiar.text: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.

modern.text: and teaching them to obey all that I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”

original.text: διδάσκοντες αὐτοὺς τηρεῖν πάντα ὅσα ἐνετειλάμην ὑμῖν· καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ μεθʼ ὑμῶν εἰμι πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ἕως τῆς συντελείας τοῦ ⸀αἰῶνος.
